user.title: Add
user.description: Add an alarm clock, or a group of alarm clocks that combines the sensors and buttons of its members.

alarm_clock.title: Add alarm clock
alarm_clock.description: Creates a new alarm clock. Alarm time, weekdays and all other settings are configured afterwards through the entities of the alarm clock.

data_description.name: Used as the device name, for example "Alarm 1".

group.title: Add group
group.description: A group combines the sensors and buttons of its members: the next alarm of all of them, and snooze and dismiss for the ones that are ringing. Members can be changed later in the group's options.

data_description.name: Used as the device name, for example "Weekdays".
data_description.members: An alarm clock can belong to several groups.

abort.already_configured: An alarm clock with this name already exists.
abort.no_alarm_clocks: Add an alarm clock first. A group combines existing alarm clocks.
abort.group_already_exists: A group with this name already exists.

init.title: Actions
init.description: Pick the phase whose actions you want to edit. Every phase is optional: without actions it still fires its event. The actions get the event data as variables (name, device_id, entry_id and the data of the phase), plus phase.

pre.title: Pre actions
pre.description: Start the pre offset before the alarm time, in minutes. They keep running when the alarm starts and are only stopped when the alarm clock is switched off. A script called directly (action: script.x) is stopped with them; one started through script.turn_on keeps running.

alarm.title: Alarm actions
alarm.description: Run while the alarm is ringing. They are stopped on snooze, on dismiss and when the alarm clock is switched off. A script called directly (action: script.x) is stopped with them; one started through script.turn_on keeps running.

snooze.title: Snooze actions
snooze.description: Run the moment the alarm is snoozed. They are only stopped when the alarm clock is switched off.

dismiss.title: Dismiss actions
dismiss.description: Run the moment the alarm ends, also when it ends because the alarm clock was switched off while ringing or snoozing.

post.title: Post actions
post.description: Start the post delay after the dismiss, in minutes. Until they are done the state is post_active; a one-shot alarm clock switches itself off only then. Switching the alarm clock off stops them. A script called directly (action: script.x) is stopped with them; one started through script.turn_on keeps running.

data_description.post_timeout: Post actions still running after this many minutes are stopped, so that a sequence that never ends cannot keep a one-shot alarm clock switched on.

group.title: Group members
group.description: Pick the alarm clocks that belong to this group. The group's sensors and buttons combine them. An alarm clock can belong to several groups.

error.invalid_actions: These actions are invalid. The log names the reason.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Snoozes a ringing alarm or extends a running snooze.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Snooze duration in minutes. 0 disables snoozing. Defaults to the configured duration.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Stops a ringing alarm or a running snooze and starts the post phase. It has no effect during the pre and the post phase; only switching the alarm clock off ends those.

trigger_alarm.name: Trigger alarm
trigger_alarm.description: Triggers the alarm immediately, for example for testing.

set_alarm.name: Set alarm
set_alarm.description: Sets the alarm time and/or the weekdays.

days.name: Weekdays
days.description: Active weekdays. An empty list means a one-shot alarm.

no_alarm_clocks_target.message: The service call did not target a loaded alarm clock.
